fn square-and-negate(x: Int) -> |Int, Int| {
    return x * x, -x
}

fn labelled(x: Int) {
    return x, "n{x}"
}

fn maybe-pair(x: Int) -> nil | |String, Int| {
    if x < 0 {
        return nil
    }
    return "ok", x
}

fn forward() { labelled(3) }

fn passthrough() { return square-and-negate(2) }

fn total(items: Dict[String, Int]) -> Int {
    let sum = 0
    for key, value in items {
        sum += #key + value
    }
    for key in items {
        sum += #key
    }
    sum
}

fn indexed(names: Array[String]) -> Array[(String, Int)] {
    let pairs: Array[(String, Int)] = []
    for name, i in names {
        pairs.push((name, i))
    }
    pairs
}

let a, b = square-and-negate(4)
let c = square-and-negate(4)
let d, e = labelled(4)
let f, g = 1, 2
let h, i = c
let j, k = (1, 2)
let l, m, n = 0, labelled(2)
let o, p = forward()
let q, r = passthrough()
let s, t = maybe-pair(4)
let u = maybe-pair(-1)
let v, w = maybe-pair(-1)
f = 7

print(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, v, w)
print(total(%{'ab': 1}), indexed(['x', 'y']))
